Willingdon Heights, Burnaby: 17 houses and 17 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October, with 1 and 2 sold in the month. It is one of 35 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Burnaby.
Willingdon Heights homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Willingdon Heights, October 2026. Detached houses: 17 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 17 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 12% (a balanced market).

In Willingdon Heights, its share of the houses listed in Burnaby went from 3.6% in June to 4.0% in October and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 1.0% to 1.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Willingdon Heights with a median price of $1,704,000 (the middle half sold between $1,604,375 and $2,121,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 33% sold above list. They had a median $694 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 4,059 square feet. 8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights with a median price of $1,090,000 (the middle half sold between $966,750 and $1,381,250), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $796 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $623 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses and 17 condos and townhomes listed in Willingdon Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Willingdon Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market); condos and townhomes had 12% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Willingdon Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses and 8 condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Willingdon Heights compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In October 2026, Willingdon Heights held 4.0% of the 430 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 1.3% of the 1,309 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 50.0% of the 34 homes listed in Willingdon Heights and condos and townhomes made up 50.0%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 33.3% and condos and townhomes 66.7%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Willingdon Heights than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses was little changed, 17 in June and 17 in October 2026 (+0.0%); condos and townhomes rose from 13 in June to 17 in October 2026 (+30.8%).

faq.q: What did houses in Willingdon Heights sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Willingdon Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,704,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.6% of the last list price (33% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
